description: This file is a Node.js script written in ECMAScript Modules syntax. It appears to automate the process of running Vitest tests across multiple extensions, managing command-line arguments, and executing batch tests in the context of a larger project. It defines functions for parsing arguments, constructing test plans, and executing tests via child processes.

methods.name: runVitestBatch
methods.description: Executes a Vitest test batch in a child process with specified parameters.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Prints usage information to the console.

methods.name: parseExtensionIds
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to extract extension IDs and remaining arguments.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates argument parsing, test plan resolution, and test execution.
